author: Michael Larabel
description: The Rust-based open-source operating system Redox OS had a very eventful September as they outlined in a status update published this weekend...
title: Redox OS Landed Nice Performance Improvements In September

author: Michael Larabel
description: Prominent Wayland developer Simon Ser sent out a merge request today for introducing the new ext-transient-output protocol. With ext-transient-output, it's intent is for helping remoting software like VNC servers in a Wayland world...
title: New Wayland Protocol Proposed For VNC/Remote Software

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linux sound subsystem maintainer Takashi Iwai of SUSE began the Linux 7.4 sound pull request by noting that "the AI flood continues" with there continuing to be a lot of new patches coming as a result of AI/LLM agents devising patches as well as uncovering new kernel bugs...
title: Linux 7.4 Sound Changes Merged: "The AI Flood Continues"

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following all the HID driver updates/additions in Linux 7.4, the input subsystem changes were merged this weekend for this new kernel version...
title: Cheap GameSir Nova Lite Gaming Controller Supported By Linux 7.4

author: Michael Larabel
description: Back in May the AV2 v1.0 specification was released for this next-generaton, royalty-free video codec. This week the Alliance For Open Media issued a press release talking up the early adoption of AV2...
title: AV2 Video Codec Adoption Talked Up, SVT-AV2 Being Developed

author: Michael Larabel
description: After nearly a decade in the Linux kernel's staging area and being worked on by many different kernel developer newcomers, the Realtek rtl8723bs was deleted from the staging area. This comes as Realtek rtl8723bs was added onto the more mature RTW88 driver in the Linux networking subsystem...
title: Realtek rtl8723bs Driver Deleted From Staging Area In Linux 7.4

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the Linux 7.4 kernel and also marked for back-porting to the v7.2 and v7.3 series is finally the ability to monitor temperature sensors on AMD 600 Series chipsets that launched alongside the Ryzen 7000 series processors...
title: AMD 600 Series Chipsets Now Have Temperature Monitoring Support On Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: Linus Torvalds merged the "char/misc" changes for the Linux 7.4 kernel driver on Saturday. Most notable this cycle for char/misc is what's being removed: Google's C-written Binder driver has left the kernel with the Rust-based modern Binder driver ready to take for the role of being used by all future Android devices...
title: Google's C Binder Driver Removed With Rust Binder Ready For "Few Billion Devices"
